The condition is now satisfied and the value is correct either way — required-now given G31 recorded is 27, which is also what liveRequiredNowToday says. It is redundant rather than false, and nothing is left undecidable. Worth noting only because a conditional field whose condition has since resolved is the kind of thing that reads as stale without being wrong.

The predecessor's fallback clause — what to do if G31 never became live — is absent here, and correctly so. D-167 settled it. Carrying that clause forward would have been dead text implying a live uncertainty that no longer exists, which is the mirror-image error of carrying forward a stale cardinality. The document does neither.

Second, staleness: D-167 and D-168 moved file 08, COORD and HEAD since this act's v1, and all 20 basedOn pins and 21 recordedInputs carry the new values and recompute. The cardinality is correspondingly fresh — limb 2 now states a single step against the live set, 'live 27-member set plus G32 (cardinality 28)', and the bare token 26 appears nowhere, so the superseded figure was not carried forward. Equally, the predecessor's fallback for G31 never landing is correctly absent now that D-167 settled it. The thirteen classes are ordered-equal by == to live actor-join v8, to the parent naming v2, and to the act's own frozen v1 — three sources, no drift — with exactly thirteen FC-JOIN tokens in the file. The owner cell matches both the live DR-114 and live DR-G12 cells, G32 has zero live rows, required-now stays 27, and D-167 is affirmed across all fourteen mentions. Two disclosures. The subject pins my v1 verdict at its post-correction digest, so the chain carries the amended bytes. And the blocker that reshaped this family is Codex's, not mine: I reviewed this act's v1 and did not catch the occupancy defect.
